description: Displayed at the CSIR aeronautics building in Brummeria, Pretoria. Identified as 210 in the Reid and Strumpfer Mirage F1 monograph, Revision 2 of August 2025, which uses detail photographs of the V3B missile launch rail taken on this airframe at the CSIR and credited to a CSIR staff photographer. The SAAF's own list transposes this airframe with 212 at the University of Pretoria; the monograph and a dated 2021 photograph of 212 at UP are preferred. Inside a controlled-access research campus.
